Name: Plaça de Gaudí
Tips: 08:15 - get the exterior photos NOW in soft light before the tour buses. The Nativity façade (the one Gaudí finished himself) faces the little lake here for the classic reflection shot.

Name: Cafés on Avinguda de Gaudí
Tips: 08:15 breakfast - croissant + café amb llet counters from ~08:00, 2-5 min from the hotel. A granja stop 5 min away does thick hot chocolate if the teens need bribing uphill.

Name: Park Güell
Tips: 09:30 entry, 30-MIN WINDOW - be at the gate by 09:30, no re-entry once you exit. Taxi/Bolt from the hotel ~15 min, 10-12 EUR (recommended over the 40-min Metro). Dragon staircase, the trencadís serpentine bench, 86-column Hypostyle Hall, best city-and-sea panorama going. ~1.5 hrs.

Name: Baixada de la Glòria escalators
Tips: Metro alternative to Park Güell - L5 to Diagonal, L3 to Vallcarca, then these outdoor escalators + a 15-min uphill walk. ~40 min total.

Name: Casa Vicens
Tips: ~11:30 on the walk down into Gràcia. Gaudí's vivid first house (1885) - the tiled facade is a free 5-min stop. Interior only if someone is smitten; it is the quiet Gaudí, no queues.

Name: Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia
Address: Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia, 08012 Barcelona
Tips: 11:15 - walk down into Gràcia (~20 min, downhill) and leave the crowds for the village squares. Low-rise, leafy, local. Pl. del Sol and Pl. de la Virreina are the other two.

Name: Menú del día on the Gràcia squares
Address: Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia / Plaça del Sol, Barcelona
Tips: 13:00 lunch, the pick. Any terrace - 3 courses + drink, the local Thursday-lunch ritual, kitchens from 13:00. Menú del día is the move at lunch all week: it makes lunch the cheap big meal, then tapas-size the dinner. Kitchens thin out after 15:30.

Name: Bodega Quimet
Tips: 13:00 lunch option - 1920s barrel bodega, vermouth, conserves, cheese/jamón boards. Atmosphere pick, light grazing rather than a hot meal.

Name: Parking Pizza
Tips: 13:00 lunch option - wood-fired Neapolitan, local crowd, teen-pleaser. ~15 min walk toward Diagonal.

Name: DelaCrem
Tips: Cult artisan gelato - a 20-min detour into Eixample. Save it for a Passeig de Gràcia evening rather than forcing it into the Gràcia block.

Name: Recinte Modernista de Sant Pau
Address: Carrer de Sant Antoni Maria Claret 167, 08025 Barcelona
Cost Range: 17 EUR/pp after 14:00, ages 12-24 11.90 EUR = 57.80 EUR for four; under 12 free
Tips: 15:45 - 10 min walk from the hotel. The world's largest Art Nouveau complex: Domènech i Montaner built a hospital as a garden city (1902-1930), twelve tiled pavilions, wards linked by flower-lined tunnels, working until 2009. Daily 09:30-18:30, last entry 18:00. Almost no queue. If the siesta ran long, the facades from Av. Gaudí are free.

Name: Avinguda de Gaudí
Tips: 17:20 - a straight 10-min pedestrian walk framed by the two UNESCO landmarks at either end. Be at the Sagrada Família entrance 17:30, passports out.

Name: Sagrada Família
Cost Range: BOOKED - Thu 27/08/2026, entry 17:45, English guided tour 18:30, code 103719876
Tips: THE FIXED POINT OF THE DAY. Tickets are NOMINATIVE - bring everyone's passport, names are checked at the door. Be at the entrance 17:30, the 15-minute entry window is enforced. Evening slot is the better one: late-August sun through the western Passion glass floods the nave red, orange and gold. Tour + free time ~2 hrs, out ~19:45 (sunset 20:34).

Name: Cervecería Catalana
Tips: 20:15 dinner in Eixample, walking distance, no Metro needed. Arrive 20:00 sharp or queue.

Name: El Nacional
Tips: 20:15 dinner option - everyone picks their own counter. Also the wet-weather swap for the Gràcia squares block.

Name: Casa Batlló
Tips: Optional nightcap walk - the Passeig de Gràcia facades (Casa Batlló + La Pedrera) lit up at night are the free version of the 40 EUR interiors we deliberately skipped. 10-min taxi if legs are dead.
